name: Occupation Rate Table
description: Publisher-side (Antipodean) reference table, loaded by P22 from verticals/antipodean/reference/occupations.csv, which is Rates.csv normalised. 6363 occupations keyed by an 8-digit code; 3000 of them are eligible for no product at all and are carried so a broker searching one gets an honest refusal rather than a missing entry. Not written by a flow or a form. The per-product columns are flat rather than nested because the supplied sheet is flat and every one of them has to be independently queryable. The per-product question set and hazard class are payload only, NOT indexed: they carry a value on 5-53% of rows and the index has no negation, so declaring them would add 27,000 rows that answer no filter over a field while looking exactly like rows that do. They are read off the record the code lookup already fetched.
label: Occupation

occupation_code.title: Occupation code
occupation_code.description: The natural key. gen_occupation stores THIS value, never the label (01-key-list.json system_keys S-06) — a wording change must not re-key every historical submission. identity_fields for the P22 loader job.

occupation_label.title: Occupation label
occupation_label.description: The second and last use of text_sortable in the whole vertical — a human-readable value both typed against and read down a list (contract artefact 2 §2.1).

occupation_category.description: ANZSIC division, the two leading digits of occupation_code. 89 distinct values across the table; the P22 load uses it as the folder.

occupation_active.title: Occupation active
occupation_active.description: ADDED BY ARTEFACT 1. A retired occupation cannot be deleted — bound policies reference it — so the lookup filters on this positive flag rather than on 'not retired'.

itpi_eligibility.description: Information Technology Professional Indemnity. Rates.csv states eligibility as yes / no / REFER — three-valued, not a boolean. 209 occupations are Refer for a product they are otherwise quotable for, which is why this replaced product_code_list: a list of eligible products cannot carry Refer.

itpi_question_set.description: Information Technology Professional Indemnity: which block of QuestionSet_v1 the quote form renders for this occupation. The join between the rate table and the question set.

itpi_hazard_class.description: Information Technology Professional Indemnity: the rate table row. ITPI is numeric 1-20 (plus 99, whose rate is 1.0 for both sections and which is a sentinel, not a rate); Allied Health is AH01-AH15; General Property is EMPTY on every row of v1.

itpi_min_excess.description: Information Technology Professional Indemnity: minimum excess, in dollars.

itpi_min_premium.description: Information Technology Professional Indemnity: minimum premium, in dollars.

itpi_default_limit_ppl.description: Default public and products liability limit.
